    seats = [ordered]@{
        player = $player.seat
        observer = $observer.seat
        adjudicator = $adjudicator.seat
        distinctSeatIds = $true
        distinctLineageIds = $true
        distinctContextDigests = $true
        lineageAuthentication = "packet-declared-and-content-addressed"
    }
    sourceIsolation = [ordered]@{
        player = $player.sourceIsolation
        observer = $observer.sourceIsolation
        adjudicatorSourceScope = $adjudicator.sourceScope
        artifactMutationAllowed = $false
        candidateAuthorMayIssueReceipt = $false
    }
    timing = $observer.timing
    learning = [ordered]@{
        requiredObjectiveIds = $requiredObjectives
        completedObjectiveIds = $completedObjectives
        teachPracticeMasterComplete = $true
    }
    comprehension = $answers
    behavior = $observer.behavior
    runtimeIssued = $false
    candidateAuthorIssued = $false
    humanEvidenceClaimed = $false
    softwareEvidenceAuthority = "role-separated cold player, observer, and adjudicator lineages"
    physicalHumanEvidence = "not-required-for-windows-software-acceptance"
    physicalInstallationEvidence = "separate-open"
    productAcceptance = "not-issued"
    playerProductTrainReceipt = $trainPath
}
$receipt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 40 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $output
$shaPath = $output + ".sha256"
$hash = File-Sha256 $output
"$hash  $([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($output))" | Set-Content -Encoding ascii $shaPath
Write-Host "UNDERDRAIN cold-seat comprehension passed its software-evidence boundary."
Write-Host "No human evidence, physical installation evidence, or player-product acceptance is claimed."
Write-Host $output
